label: Answers to an older request change nothing
code: if (event is Event.Answer && event.gen != state.gen) return state

label: Opening the screen starts a fresh request
Refresh keeps content on screen, reloads an empty one
Retry only from the error screen
code: is Event.Retry -> if (state is Screen.Error) Screen.Loading(event.gen) else state

label: An answer with orders, or with none
code: is Event.Success -> if (event.items.isEmpty()) Screen.Empty(event.gen) else Screen.Content(event.items, refreshing = false, notice = null, gen = event.gen)

label: A failed answer
code: is Event.Failure -> if (state is Screen.Content) state.copy(refreshing = false, notice = event.message) else Screen.Error(event.message, event.gen)

label: Answers to an older request change nothing
code: if (state is Screen.Loading && event is Event.Answer && event.gen != state.gen) return state

label: An answer with orders, or with none
code: is Event.Success -> Screen.Content(event.items, refreshing = false, notice = null, gen = event.gen)
